description:
Halloran does not need the help. He says so twice, while clearing you a space at the bench and moving the good light over.

The Watch run on things that were made rather than bought, and the making gets done by whoever is standing there when it needs doing. Today that is you. There is no trick to it and nobody is watching to see if you fail.

Halloran will notice that you came.
name: Bench Time

objectives.desc: Make something. Anything. Bring it back made rather than bought.
emotes: {who} works with their hands and does not look up for a while.
{who} gets it wrong, sets it down, and starts the same piece again without comment.
{who} holds the finished thing up to the good light and finds it acceptable.
